html:
Cao Bang is an ideal place to avoid the heat in every summer day, chosen by many tourists as a stopover during their vacation, where there are caves and clear streams, a relatively cool climate all year round, and majestic natural scenery that is very suitable for tourists to avoid the heat.

Located about 300 km from Hanoi, Cao Bang is an ideal destination for every summer, if you are a lover of peaceful space, away from the hustle and bustle of the bustling city, travel Cao Bang in the summer to immerse yourself in the peaceful natural scenery.

Coming to Cao Bang, visitors not only admire the beautiful natural scenery, but also soak in the cool stream, experience the culture of the highlands or sit on the rocks watching the rivers of grass, trees and flowers and enjoy the local cuisine will bring you the most enjoyable vacation, dispelling the hustle and bustle of the bustling city.

The most beautiful sun-sheltering spots in Cao Bang you should visit at least once in your life

Pac Bo Cave

If you have the opportunity to visit Cao Bang, visit the Pac Bo Cave relic site, a beautiful stop every summer, when immersing yourself in the cool water, visitors will forget all the stuffiness in the bustling city, when visiting Lenin stream, visitors will see the clear stream surrounded by trees and grass, the chirping of birds will make your soul feel more relaxed than ever.

A masterpiece that nature has bestowed upon Cao Bang is Ban Gioc waterfall – Nguom Ngao cave, a destination sought after by many backpackers every summer, the waterfall becomes more crowded than ever, not only for sightseeing but also for coming here on a summer day, you can immerse yourself in the festival taking place right next to the waterfall.

Even on a hot summer day, when you come to the waterfall, the water from above pours down, emitting cool steam. In the distance are green grass carpets. Visitors can sit on the river and watch the waterfall, take souvenir photos and immerse themselves in the idyllic scenery in the middle of the forest.

Coming to Nguom Ngao cave, visitors can also encounter stalactites that look like terraced fields. When entering the cave, visitors will feel cool. Although it is sunny outside, the temperature inside the cave fluctuates around 20 degrees Celsius. The stalactites look like young trees, bamboo shoots and animals in a very unique natural way. Visitors can take beautiful photos next to Nguom Ngao cave. No matter what season of the year you travel to Cao Bang, Nguom Ngao cave is a destination you cannot miss.

If you are someone who wants to experience resort tours, visit the Kolia Organic Farm eco-tourism area, Phja Oac peak, Phja Den Salmon Farm… to feel the beauty that nature has bestowed on Cao Bang, the summer days here are quite cool and have a rich flora and fauna. In addition, there are azaleas, blue hydrangeas, orchids, beautiful roses… competing to show off their colors, which are beautiful check-in spots that many tourists come to. In addition, you can freely check in at the bamboo forest, flower garden, in the afternoon enjoy sticky rice, wild vegetables, roast pork, visitors can light a campfire at night to chat together and enjoy rustic cuisine.

Lung To Dam and Nam Ngua Waterfall are destinations that many tourists seek when traveling Cao Bang tour. If you are a person who loves to admire the wild natural scenery, Lung To Dam and Nam Ngua Waterfall are the destination for you. With a white waterfall winding around the deep green forest, visitors can soak in the cool water from nature to dispel all the daily fatigue and blend in with the natural scenery.

In addition, Cao Bang also has an interesting sun-avoiding spot at Kem Coong, Hong Nam commune, a camping spot chosen by many young people. There is a swimming pool next to the cliff, a majestic scene. The stream is not deep and the water flows slowly. You can see schools of fish swimming around, or experience catching natural snails next to the rock, which will bring visitors a feeling of excitement.

Ban Sa Waterfall, Thoong Sao Waterfall, Tien Waterfall, Thang Hen Lake are destinations chosen by many tourists to cool off in the summer. You don’t need to spend too much time exploring Cao Bang’s scenic spots. You just need to take a 3-day, 2-night Cao Bang tour to discover all the beauty and experience daily life with the local people.
